local_validation.frontend_prettier_and_build: Passed during the preceding local implementation stage; not rerun during this release stage.
local_validation.focused_independent_read_only_code_revie: No blocking findings after fixes; static review only, not an audit.

live_acceptance.identities: owner and a distinct verified Google recipient identity
live_acceptance.unauthorized_shell_and_private_files_req: owner denied; no added access was granted
live_acceptance.separate_read_converse_request: owner approved against the already approved Document version

order_5_approved_request_invitation.redemption: passed by the bound recipient identity

live_acceptance.followup_grant: distinct inspect-only grant and fresh session
live_acceptance.separate_direct_invitation_wrong_identit: A new direct invitation for the same approved synthetic version and recipient (separate from the order-5 approved-request invitation) was first opened under the owner's different Google identity and rejected; the bound recipient then redeemed that same link successfully.

unauthenticated_api_probes.post_owner_decision_without_origin_or_co: HTTP 403; same-origin guard response (Use the same-origin JSON interface).

live_acceptance.database_crosscheck: read-only SQLite inspection confirmed approved/denied request records, source verify versus follow-up inspect grants, and distinct sessions

current_demo_budget_checkpoint.note: Application reservation limit only; not a provider billing cap. Point-in-time checkpoint.

limitations: The focused independent review was static and does not establish broad security or pilot readiness.
Wrong-identity testing used a separate direct invitation, not the invitation created by the order-5 approval flow.
Unauthenticated API probes exercised only owner-state and owner-decision endpoints; no authenticated cross-role API request was tested.
Frontend Prettier/build checks were passed during the preceding local implementation stage and were not rerun during the release stage.
No model behavior or Kata execution was evaluated during order 5 live acceptance.
The $10 application ceiling is not a provider billing cap.
A redeemed follow-up grant has an independent revocation lifecycle; revocation cannot recall information already viewed or saved.
